purpose: Map every MQA-N (manual-QA scenario) to its in-scope REQ-N (mission requirement) so the /a2z-ship manualQA phase can read this file and assert per-scenario coverage without traversing mission_goal_trace.json. Source of truth for AC mapping is .a2z/mission-state/<cid>/mission_goal_trace.json (30 REQ rows) which references manualqa_row per requirement.
